translation: O brother! One day in Nīlāchal at the time of honouring prasādam, Mahāprabhu Śrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya said to the devotees, “Be fortunate today by honouring khichuḍi with pure hearts.

text: ākaṇṭha bhojana kari’    bala mukhe hari hari
translation: “Lord Jagannātha has given you khichuḍi, pancakes, sherbet, and various other types of wonderful prasād. Eat up to your neck and chant the Name of Hari! Ignorance and sin will disappear.

“Lord Jagannātha’s prasād is honoured by Lord Brahmā and Lord Śiva. If you eat it, divine love will arise within you. You all have now attained such a precious treasure. Glory! Glory! Glory to Lord Jagannātha!”
